name: obi-sphere-server
description: The Sphere server: the Obi-to-Obi protocol v0.1's directory, invitations, tokens, policy, relay and audit chain, on Cloudflare Workers with D1.

SPHERE_OPERATOR_TOKEN.description: Paste the token Oby copied: in Oby, Settings › Obysphere › Host your own › Deploy… makes it, and keeps it for creating Obyspheres once you paste your Worker's address back ([how](https://github.com/obi-ai-bot/obi-sphere/blob/main/docs/run-your-own.md)).

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional: leave it empty. To add Google sign-in later, so your team can create Obyspheres without the token, set it in your repository's `wrangler.jsonc` ([how](https://github.com/obi-ai-bot/obi-sphere/blob/main/docs/run-your-own.md#optional-let-your-team-create-obyspheres)).

CREATOR_WORKSPACES.description: Optional: leave it empty. With Google sign-in, the Google Workspace domains whose people may create Obyspheres, comma-separated, like `acme.com`; set it in your repository's `wrangler.jsonc` with `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`.
